about: S03 shot list for hybrid/run-clips.mjs, frames.mjs and spec.mjs.

shots.name: open
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. A very slow gentle drift forward through a dusk sky, no zoom, no cuts. Three tiny floating miniature islands hang among soft violet and rose clouds and bob very gently up and down; the clouds drift slowly past; string lights and a window glow warmly; a few birds glide far away. Tilt-shift miniature diorama, calm and full of wonder.

shots.name: m1
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. The camera glides smoothly forward through the soft dusk clouds toward one small floating island with a brick city rooftop terrace and glowing string lights, and settles on it. The tiny figurines stay exactly where they are on their islands, frozen in place: nobody walks, runs, jumps, floats or leaves an island, nobody grows or shrinks. Only the camera moves. No cuts, no fades, no morphing. One smooth camera move, no cuts, no morphing. Tilt-shift miniature diorama.

shots.name: rooftop
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. Very slow, very slight push-in; the whole island stays in frame the entire time; no zoom, no cuts. A tiny city rooftop engagement session on a floating island at dusk. The young couple stand close under the glowing string lights; she laughs and rests her head on his shoulder, he kisses her forehead, then they turn to face each other and dance a slow step. The photographer, a woman with a salt-and-pepper bun, glasses and a charcoal gilet, holds her tan camera to her eye and presses the shutter, then lowers it, checks the back of the camera and smiles. The string lights twinkle, soft rose dusk sky, violet clouds drifting below the island. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fog, no fade, no mist. Same faces, same clothes, nothing drifts. Feels romantic and warm.

shots.name: m2
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. The camera lifts up and away from the small rooftop island, flies smoothly through the clouds as the sky deepens from dusk to night with stars, and glides down to a small floating island with a cosy editing nook and a warm glowing lamp. The tiny figurines stay exactly where they are on their islands, frozen in place: nobody walks, runs, jumps, floats or leaves an island, nobody grows or shrinks. Only the camera moves. No cuts, no fades, no morphing. One smooth camera move, no cuts, no morphing. Tilt-shift miniature diorama.

shots.name: desk
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. Very slow, very slight push-in; the whole island stays in frame the entire time; no zoom, no cuts. A tiny night editing nook on a floating island at 11:40 PM. The photographer, a woman with a salt-and-pepper bun, glasses and a charcoal gilet, sits at her desk, leans toward the glowing monitor, moves the mouse, sips from her mug, then sits back and smiles with quiet satisfaction. The monitor glows with soft abstract warm light, the brass lamp glows, a little steam rises from the mug, stars twinkle outside the round window, indigo clouds drift below the island. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fog, no fade, no mist. Same face, same clothes, nothing drifts. Feels cosy, focused and quiet.

shots.name: m3
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. The camera lifts up and away from the small night editing island, flies smoothly through the clouds as the dark sky brightens into soft morning light, and glides down to a small floating island with a cosy living room and a green sofa. The tiny figurines stay exactly where they are on their islands, frozen in place: nobody walks, runs, jumps, floats or leaves an island, nobody grows or shrinks. Only the camera moves. No cuts, no fades, no morphing. One smooth camera move, no cuts, no morphing. Tilt-shift miniature diorama.

shots.name: living
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. Very slow, very slight push-in; the whole island stays in frame the entire time; no zoom, no cuts. A tiny cosy living room on a floating island at 8 AM. The young couple sit close on the green sofa with a laptop on his knees, its screen glowing softly. She gasps and covers her mouth with her hand, then laughs, he grins and squeezes her shoulder, and they lean in together toward the glowing screen. Warm morning sun streams through the window with floating dust motes, peach clouds drift below the island. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fog, no fade, no mist. Same faces, same clothes, nothing drifts. Feels joyful, intimate and warm.

toast.title: Client opened their gallery for the first time

shots.name: m4
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. The camera pulls slowly up and back from the small living room island, rising into the sunrise sky until three small floating islands are all in view among peach and lavender clouds. The tiny figurines stay exactly where they are on their islands, frozen in place: nobody walks, runs, jumps, floats or leaves an island, nobody grows or shrinks. Only the camera moves. No cuts, no fades, no morphing. One smooth camera move, no cuts, no morphing. Tilt-shift miniature diorama.

shots.name: finale
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. A very slow gentle pull-back, no zoom, no cuts. Three tiny floating islands glow in a soft sunrise sky above peach and lavender clouds, their tiny warm lights still twinkling: string lights on a rooftop, a desk lamp, sunlight in a living room window. The islands bob very gently, the clouds drift slowly, the last stars fade. Feels peaceful, a job well finished.
